2519-01:q1.evidence: Good detail: you named the feature, the technique and the number of test cases. Add one real defect you found and what happened to it. Interviewers remember a specific bug far longer than a count.
2519-01:q1.technicalAccuracy: Boundary value analysis is used correctly. One slip: checking that a single field rejects 0 and 100 is a unit test, not an integration test. An integration test would check that the quantity reaches the cart and changes the total.
2519-01:q1.nextStep: Rewrite your last two sentences so they end with a result: what your tests caught, and what the team changed because of it.
